title: Red Hat Security Advisory: qt5-qtbase security update
description: Two denial of service vulnerabilities have been identified in the Qt software toolkit's qt5-qtbase packages, specifically related to XML serialization and XML parsing. These vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to cause a denial of service via uncontrolled recursion during XML processing. Red Hat has issued a security advisory and released updates for affected Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.4 versions to address these issues.
